concept.title: Install the Git Client
concept.shortdesc: Add the Git Client to in one of two ways, then restart to begin using it.

conbody.p: There are two ways to install the Git Client:

ul.li: Drag an Install button into the editor. This is the quickest way and works in 26.1 and newer.
Install from the update site or a downloaded package. Use this when the drag-and-drop button is not available or the update site cannot be reached.

conbody.p: After you restart, the three Git views (Staging, History, Branch Manager), the menu, and the contextual Git actions become available.
